notes: All monetary amounts are SAR units, scaled only from published SAR millions. Company USD convenience columns were not used. IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia; pre-IPO2016 comparative uses IFRS in the prospectus.

revenue is the consolidated Revenue line, excluding separately presented other income related to sales. Before2017, production royalties were deducted from revenue; from2017 royalties are operating costs. The2017 revenue835,983m is the later IPO prospectus comparative under IFRS15 rather than the earlier summary840,483m. This change limits across-year comparability.

netIncome and totalEquity are attributable to parent shareholders, excluding non-controlling interests. totalDebt is the company-published total borrowings(current and non-current), not a sum reconstructed from components. capex is company-published capital expenditures, negative as in cash flows.

Shares outstanding are null because directly comparable period-end shares net of treasury were not located; issued shares and EPS weighted averages were not substituted. dividends per share left null where only quarterly amounts were located; these were not summed.

employees for2016–2018 cover Saudi Aramco and its wholly owned subsidiaries, as explicitly published in IPO prospectus p.120 (PDF201). Later annual headcounts have not been substituted from narrower parent-only disclosures.

EPS is the annual figure actually published in the selected report; earlier periods are not mathematically adjusted for later bonus issues.2022 is shown in the2023 report on its retrospectively bonus-adjusted basis. IFRS16 adopted2019 prospectively,2020 includes SABIC consolidation.
